visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a black cap and jacket stands outdoors, holding a microphone and speaking directly to the camera while a blurred crowd and city buildings are visible behind him. (2) The scene shifts to the man running along a street wearing a blue athletic tank top, his expression determined and his body in motion as he passes trees and residential gates. (3) On a bright day, he continues running on a wide road with a concrete barrier, briefly looking towards another person off-camera while maintaining a steady pace. (4) A still image shows the man lying on a colorful mat outdoors, appearing completely exhausted after a race, followed by a shot of him running away from the camera on a paved path near a river. (5) He is seen crossing a marathon finish line with his arms raised in triumph, then sitting on the ground exhausted but smiling, wearing white compression socks and holding a race bib. (6) Close-up shots feature blue and silver running shoes in motion on pavement, and the man running shirtless on a road during sunset. (7) Back at the event area, he holds several purple balloons and wears a finisher's medal, posing with the running shoes and smiling at the camera. (8) He is seen eating a cookie and interacting with other runners in a crowded event space before shifting to footage of him training in various locations, including a group photo with several other athletes. (9) He runs through city streets with large purple billboards in the background and eventually crosses another finish line, gesturing victory to the crowd. (10) The video concludes with him running away on an urban road while large text overlays the screen.
